sha_binding.note: fc8b7d09fac867fd0b1a2502b2e743ad0c69433f is the last commit on this lane that changes anything outside docs/06_status/proof/UTV2-1892/. It is the branch-refresh merge commit produced by `ops:merge-wrapper pr-update-branch`, which reconciled the lane onto origin/main 96c990286932112a73ddb4108b0148b8894ca296. This is the second such refresh on this PR: the automated readiness-ledger job advances main every few hours and branch protection sets strict:true, so an open PR goes BEHIND on its own. Each refresh moves the anchor, because scripts/ci/proof-binding-validator.ts rule 4 compares trees (git diff --name-only <anchor>..HEAD) and the ledger file would otherwise read as non-proof drift. Neither refresh produced a conflict and neither changed an implementation file: each introduced exactly docs/06_status/readiness/readiness-score.json, and git diff --stat 3379b4b66 fc8b7d09f -- scripts/ .github/ .ops/ docs/06_status/proof/ docs/06_status/lanes/ is empty. Superseded anchors, in order and none withdrawn: d9d5a533bbdc61888b368677d8a8e5efd73d2a12 (the lane-pr-binding workflow's own commit, which wrote pr_url into docs/06_status/lanes/UTV2-1892.json once PR #1570 was reopened) and 3379b4b66c775612528d000b8efa6ab565d07853 (the first branch refresh). PR #1570 was closed on 2026-09-14 to release its locks on the two parser files so the canonical-`Bounce:` repair (UTV2-1926) could take them; that repair has landed, and the PR was reopened on 2026-09-21 under the same UTV2-1892 authority -- no new tracker issue was minted. The lane was readmitted with `ops:lane-start --readmit-existing-branch --singleton-approved`, which re-pinned file_scope_lock to the five files this bundle measures, and was first reconciled onto origin/main 6846fe19fb83158aa1735c47c922e6d5c582d234 by merge commit 71c7fa65a. That merge had exactly one conflict, in scripts/ops/merge-gate-verdict.test.ts, where this lane and UTV2-1926 had both appended tests to the end of the same file; both sets are kept and 38/38 pass. Every measurement in this bundle was taken at the current anchor, not carried forward from an earlier edition. Merge SHA is null until post-merge-lane-close.yml rebinds it.
